episodes.synopsis: Down on his luck and freshly unemployed Kentaro applies for one last job. He thinks he bombs the interview – but Manpuku Entertainment Productions has plans for him!
episodes.title: Reemployment

episodes.synopsis: Kentaro is hired along with other mid-career, middle aged men, to become a new idol group, the Eternal Boys! The group records their introduction to the world.
episodes.title: Company Housing

episodes.synopsis: The lessons for the debut of the Ossan Idol Project, Eternal Boys, began! But singing and dancing at the same time is hard.
episodes.title: Work Commences

episodes.synopsis: A little liquid courage may be the key to unlocking idol worthy dance moves!
episodes.title: The Kentaro Sanada

episodes.synopsis: Today's agenda: making the Eternal Boys' first music video!
episodes.title: MV

episodes.synopsis: There are two kinds of humans: the ones who give, and the ones who receive.
episodes.title: Makoto Kakizaki Special

episodes.synopsis: What's more exciting than the Eternal Boys getting 100,000 views on their first video? Their first public performance, that's what!
episodes.title: The First Show

episodes.synopsis: The boys have their first CD sales meeting. They also deal with living as roommates; who's wearing whose socks?!
episodes.title: CD Debut

episodes.synopsis: Ishida recalls fond memories of the idol group, Gentlemen! Now he's in an idol group himself. Will these worlds collide?
episodes.title: The Dawn of Naoki Ishida

episodes.synopsis: The Men's Idol Fest only happens once a year and the Eternal Boys are making their way to its stage! It’s like being catapulted to the champions league!
episodes.title: Idol Festival

episodes.synopsis: An embarrassing blunder lands Yamanaka-san in hot water. It looks like things are about to go "kaboom!"
episodes.title: Daisuke Yamanaka's Way

episodes.synopsis: Ima-chan's solo song "100% Your Personal Space" is beyond cute! The Eternal Boys get nitty gritty with lyrics.
episodes.title: A Day Off

episodes.synopsis: Is Sanada really going to quit the Eternal Boys just when they're getting started?!
episodes.title: Retirement

episodes.synopsis: Good news, everyone! Kakizaki is bringing a new member to the Eternal Boys!
episodes.title: Mid-Term Hiring Exam

episodes.synopsis: You know the old saying: you can take the boy out of the idol, but you can't take the idol out of the boy!
episodes.title: The Continent of Passionate Tsuyoshi Imagawa

episodes.synopsis: Sometimes, you can't teach an old dog new tricks. Sometimes you can!
episodes.title: Local Business

episodes.synopsis: Haru Asai grapples with his career as a professional soccer player turned middle-aged idol! It might be time once again to play ball!
episodes.title: The History of Haru Asai

episodes.synopsis: The Eternal Boys browse the best website on the entire world wide web: the Eternal Boys' official fan site!
episodes.title: Scandal

episodes.synopsis: The Eternal Boys feel the love online from their fans! So does Manpuku Entertainment Productions' company cat, Pepechan!
episodes.title: CM

episodes.synopsis: Life as a middle-aged idol isn't all stage lights, show tunes and joint cream; the boys have some tough conversations.
episodes.title: Unprofitable Business

episodes.synopsis: One of the Eternal Boys feels like he's going back to school. Imagine doing homework again. No thanks!
episodes.title: From Nicolai Asakura's Car Window

episodes.synopsis: The Eternal Boys receive a package. But what's in the box?!
episodes.title: Album

episodes.synopsis: The Eternal Boys have been working toward this moment for their entire idol careers! It's time to perform!
episodes.title: Budokan

episodes.synopsis: In the afterglow of their stage performance, what does the future hold for the Eternal Boys?
episodes.title: Eternal Boys
